verdict.rationale: Marketing copy says users can query data across Mercury, Gusto, Carta and Stripe from one surface. It also says the AI turns goals into revenue modeling, cohort analysis and KPI alerts, and builds a tailored ops plan from company details, which amounts to AI-generated suggestions. The evidence is only vendor claims and frames analysis as steps toward a goal rather than as a dedicated insights feature. Missing for 10: an explicit AI insights or recommendations surface over connected data, documentation of what insights are produced and how they are shown, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
